spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cut, divided.
E.
छो to cut, affix क्त, deriv irr.

m. (-त्तिः)
1 Cutting, division.
2 A plant, (Galedupa arborea): see करज.
E.
छिद to cut, affix क्तिन्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Roguish, fraudulent, knavish, a knave.
2 Hostile, inimical, a foe.
3 Cutting or fit for cutting, (a weapon, &c.)
E.
छिद to cut, स्वरच् Uṇādi affix, and त optionally substituted for the radical final, otherwise छिद्वर.

ind.
Having cut or divided.
E.
छिद to cut, क्त्वा aff.
